about.body: The AJ150D is a Inline-3 (I3), 1.5L (1,497 cc), Diesel engine used across Land Rover's 2 model range, in production 2018–present. We rebuild every AJ150D to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.
